item: row 311 (R790): maps freshness from the cut countries' own data dates
summary: The Maps column said the date of the map data was not recorded although the lane holds each cut country's data date. The daily block now gives the newest and oldest country_data_date over the cut countries (last applied file's own date, else the extract's), names countries applied with no date read apart and leaves them out of both, counts extracts with no date apart; downloads not yet cut stay not recorded; with no cut country the row reads as before. 10 strings x12.
